nodes.label: .`a clock with no probes reports UNKNOWN rather than guessing`()
.`stamps that track elapsed realtime classify as ELAPSED_REALTIME`()
.`stamps that track uptime classify as UPTIME`()
.`stamps on a base that matches neither classify as UNKNOWN`()
.`when both bases agree the documented intent wins`()
.`classification needs more than ninety percent agreement`()
.`agreement is judged within one second, so ordinary latency does not disqualify a device`()
.`the reported offset is the median of arrival minus event`()
.`a clock with no probes reports a zero offset rather than dividing by nothing`()
.`the median is taken over a bounded reservoir so a long drive cannot grow it`()
.`two sensor stamps map to wall times the same distance apart`()
.`the mapping is anchored and does not move between calls`()
.`the date pattern uses a dot before the milliseconds`()
.`a formatted date matches the shape the loader parses`()
.`the date carries milliseconds and does not round them away`()
.`the date carries no quotes, unlike the dataset it is compared against`()
.`each formatter is a fresh instance because SimpleDateFormat is not thread safe`()
